Implemented the root-cause fix and attached `final.patch`.

The search URL is now replaced with an engine base URL only when the original entry is a single bare engine name. Multi-word searches—including entries whose explicit search term or trailing word matches another engine name—retain the intended search host and full encoded query.

- `test path-search`
- `blub path-search`
